message: No detected input validation: The only check is an assertion that at least one image was found; there are no schema, dtype, value-range, or dimension validations on the loaded image data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded entirely from local filesystem paths; no remote sources are accessed, so no integrity verification or authentication is performed.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only prints class distribution summaries but does not validate label values against an expected set, compare distributions for anomalies, or use any label-noise detection tool like Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection routines, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples before fitting the model.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains a new model from scratch and saves it, but there is no loading of pretrained weights or serialized models with any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense implemented in this training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train/test splits exist via folder paths, there is no cryptographic signing/hashing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement, and only a single set of metrics (precision, recall, F1, IoU) with no independent verification mechanism.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (predict via graph.evaluate) loads images and passes them directly to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: The predicted cls_map and color_map are used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or output bounds validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision segmentation model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
